I didn't understand anything. There was another driver at the stand who spoke a little English. All foreign tourists went in his taxi. I just stood there. One day my daughter said, "Papa, you should learn too." Then she showed me the SpeakEasy app. There was a 1 rupee trial. I said, you can't even get tea for 1 rupee, let's try it. Here Vani AI explains in Hindi. I started spoken English from basic. I used to practice while waiting at signals and after going home at night. How to greet tourists, how to explain local places, how to ask for payment politely. If I spoke wrong, Vani corrected me immediately. Even if she corrected me 100 times, she never said you are a taxi driver, why do you need English? Now foreign tourists call me directly. My name is on Google reviews. I earn 70,000 a month. So madam, if a taxi driver can learn English, then anyone can. If you want to learn English, download the SpeakEasy app and practice with Vani AI. There is a 1 rupee trial, cheaper than tea.] Speaker C: अभी SpeakEasy app डाउनलोड करें और फर्राटेदार English बोलना शुरू करें। [Download the SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
